name: Gösgen
summary: The Caltech–SIN–TUM programme at Gösgen compared reactor-antineutrino spectra at several tens of metres. Moving the same detector between baselines reduced dependence on an absolute source calculation and supplied important early disappearance constraints.
detection_principle: Inverse beta decay is identified through positron signals in segmented scintillator and a delayed neutron tag. Relative spectra at different core distances are tested for energy-dependent disappearance.

results.summary: The measured spectra were consistent with no oscillations in the tested region, with limits from both relative-only and source-constrained analyses.
